name: Smooth Peanut Satay Noodle & Chicken Sauce
whyItWorks: Smooth creamy peanut butter thinned with warm chicken broth delivers rich calories and savory flavor with zero nut shards.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter with 1/4 cup warm chicken bone broth, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp maple syrup, and a pinch of ground ginger.
